name: Raja Ravi Varma Gold Medal Painting Competition
organiser: Manorama Nallapadam & Delhi Public School, Kochi
note: At DPS campus, Athani, Nedumbassery, from 10 am. Advance registration is required (free). Categories: Playschool, Pre-Primary, Primary (Class 1–3), Upper Primary (Class 4–7). Bring crayons, colour pencils, watercolours or oil pastels. Enquiries: 96455 51191 (as given in the news report).

name: National Level Science Talent Search Exam (NSTSE)
mode: Offline via school, or online direct
note: Through your school: offline exam on 20 Nov or 2 Dec 2026. Without the school: parents can register directly on unifiedcouncil.com and the child takes an online exam on 24 Jan 2027 (practice test 17 Jan).
